description: Repo-scale (kotlin-inventory): add pagination to GET /api/items that must compose with the existing warehouseId/low filters, not bypass them
prompts: Add pagination to GET /api/items: accept `page` (1-based, default 1) and `pageSize` (default 20, max 100) query parameters, both positive integers - reject with 400 otherwise. The response body changes shape to `{ items, total, page, pageSize }`, where `items` is just that page's slice and `total` is the count of ALL matching items (not just the page). Pagination must be applied AFTER the existing `warehouseId` and `low` filters, not before - `total` must reflect the filtered count, and the returned `items` must be the correct page of the FILTERED result set.
name: add_kotlin_inventory_items_pagination
